descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-02 Patient List Capture · S01 Hospital: a clean census screenshot adds every patient with no re-typing

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 A screenshot or photo of a patient list, sent for capture, adds the patients to the list automatically via OCR, with no manual re-typing. (UAT TC-02; TFA-92580 AC 2; TFA-92580 How it works 2-3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa
  • U6 New patients get a Follow-up badge: scanned ones (including the new ones from a day-2 scan) and manually added ones. (UAT TC-02; TFA-92580 AC 4; TFA-92580 How it works 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa
  • U9 Runs and passes in both contexts: the Hospital capture (camera icon) and the Nursing Home 'Scan Resident List' (3.3). (UAT 3.3; TFA-92580 How it works 1) — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Fresh @roundai.test physician on the local stack, on the Hospital list (fixture patient only)

When Scan patient list from photo → Take Photo or Choose Image → upload h-day1-clean.png → confirm all rows

Then The 3 rows show with the name, room, diagnosis and MRN from the image. After confirming, all 3 are on the Hospital list next to the fixture patient, and each scanned patient's chart opens at Follow-up

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs on the checkpoints below. 'No re-typing' (U1) is decided by a post-run read of the MCP session log: any browser_type call between the upload and the s01-list checkpoint fails the case. Follow-up is judged on the chart's selected admission status (U6). A preflight failure makes this Blocked, not Fail

Where it ran: dev; test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S01 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-02.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: PW · Playwright script (PW (real image through setInputFiles, real scan path)); secondary: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
